title: The Post-School Stall
context: Pilot (Teen) arrives home. Their 'State' gauge is Amber (Stabilization). Ground Control (Parent) wants to discuss a missing assignment ('Direction').

roles.pilot: You are running on fumes. Your social battery is dead, and your brain is foggy.
roles.groundControl: You just got an email from the teacher and are anxious to fix the problem.

theCrash.parent: Why didn't you turn in your history paper? You always do this.
theCrash.teen: Leave me alone! I just got home, why are you always on my case?
theCrash.outcome: System Overload. Both vehicles sustain damage.

theInGaugeOptimization.parent: I see your 'State' gauge is Amber right now. I have a 'Direction' question about history, but I'll park it until you've had time to refuel.
theInGaugeOptimization.teen: Copy that. My system is lagging. Give me a 30-minute Garage Reset, and then we can look at the Road Map.
theInGaugeOptimization.outcome: Collision Avoided. Tier 1 capacity is restored before Tier 3 demands are made.

title: The Radar Drop
context: Pilot's 'Connection' gauge has been Red for two days. They are isolating in their room. Ground Control is getting anxious about the disconnect.

roles.pilot: You feel overwhelmed by friends and just want the Privacy Curtain closed.
roles.groundControl: You feel shut out and worried that something is deeply wrong.

theCrash.parent: Why are you hiding in your room? You never talk to us anymore. What is wrong with you?
theCrash.teen: Nothing is wrong! Stop spying on me!
theCrash.outcome: Defensive Escapism. The Pilot locks the doors; Ground Control panics.

theInGaugeOptimization.parent: Hey Pilot, the dashboard shows your 'Connection' gauge has been Red for a bit. In the past, this tends to mean you just need solo maintenance. 5 out of 7 times, a low-pressure movie night helps. Want to try that later, or stay in solo mode?
theInGaugeOptimization.teen: Solo mode for now. The system is just heavy. I'll drop the Privacy Curtain a bit tomorrow.
theInGaugeOptimization.outcome: Autonomy Preserved. Parent offers support without interrogation; Teen acknowledges the data without shame.

title: The Mutual Overheating
context: It's 10:00 PM. Both Pilot and Ground Control have Red 'Emotion' and 'State' gauges after a disagreement about curfew.

roles.pilot: You feel unfairly controlled and your RPMs are maxed out.
roles.groundControl: You feel disrespected and your patience (Fuel) is at zero.

theCrash.parent: You are grounded! Give me your phone right now!
theCrash.teen: I hate living here! You don't trust me!
theCrash.outcome: Head-On Collision. Severe damage to long-term trust.

theInGaugeOptimization.parent: Warning light. My 'State' is Red and yours is too. We don't have the capacity for this maneuver right now. I'm initiating a 20-minute Fleet Lockdown.
theInGaugeOptimization.outcome: Emergency Brakes Engaged. The conflict is paused before permanent relational damage occurs.
